findings.issue: The privacy policy does not disclose the third parties (SDKs) that collect personal information through the DLA.
findings.doc_evidence: The privacy policy on the website does not name these third parties.
findings.fix: The privacy policy must explicitly disclose the names of the third-party SDKs (analytics, advertising, and device-fingerprinting) that collect personal information through the DLA.

findings.issue: The app accesses the list of installed apps and reads files in the download folder, which is not permitted unless for one-time onboarding/KYC purposes with explicit consent.
findings.doc_evidence: For fraud checks, the app scans the list of installed apps and reads files in the download folder.
findings.fix: Access to installed apps and files in the download folder should be restricted to one-time onboarding/KYC purposes with explicit borrower consent and an audit trail.

findings.issue: The app accesses mobile phone resources (installed apps and files in the download folder) without being limited to one-time access for onboarding/KYC purposes.
findings.doc_evidence: For fraud checks, the app scans the list of installed apps and reads files in the download folder.
findings.fix: Access to mobile phone resources like installed apps and files in the download folder should be limited to one-time access for onboarding/KYC purposes only, with explicit borrower consent.

findings.issue: The LSP (SwiftStack) is storing personal information of borrowers beyond basic minimal data, which is not allowed unless explicitly permitted by statutory guidelines.
findings.doc_evidence: All data, including SDK data, is stored on servers in Mumbai.
findings.fix: The LSP should only store basic minimal data (name, address, contact details) and ensure that the RE (Nilgiri Bank) is responsible for data privacy and security.

findings.issue: There is no mention of whether biometric data is stored or collected, which is prohibited unless allowed under extant statutory guidelines.
findings.doc_evidence: All data, including SDK data, is stored on servers in Mumbai.
findings.fix: The product document should explicitly state whether biometric data is collected or stored, and if so, confirm that it is allowed under extant statutory guidelines.
